item.title: Wednesday, 11 February, 2026
item.dc:creator: Chris Wiegman
item.description: Each note has its own front matter with a title and a date. Group them by year in folders so the archive stays tidy as the collection grows. They also get their own RSS feed at /notes/index.xml, separate from the main blog feed.
item.content:encoded:
Each note has its own front matter with a title and a date. Group them by year in folders so the archive stays tidy as the collection grows.

They also get their own RSS feed at /notes/index.xml, separate from the main blog feed.

item.title: Monday, 5 January, 2026
item.dc:creator: Chris Wiegman
item.description: Notes are short-form content. They render inline on the notes page instead of getting a page of their own, which makes them perfect for quick thoughts you don&rsquo;t want to turn into a full post.
